title: naija-data
tagline: Sourced Nigerian reference data, in three languages.
summary: States, LGAs, 8,809 wards, banks and phone-number rules for Python, JavaScript and Go, plus a free REST API. Every record has a source, and every language gives the same answer.
problem: Nigerian developers copy state and LGA lists from random blog posts, with no source and plenty of mistakes.
note: MIT for the code, CC BY 4.0 for the data.
features: Published on PyPI, npm and Go, plus django-naija for Django
13,392 shared test cases run in every language
A free REST API on Cloudflare Workers
why: Nigerian apps need states, LGAs, wards, banks and phone rules, and most lists online have no source. As a statistician I wanted reference data with a source for every record, giving the same answer in every language.
hard: 13,392 shared test cases run in CI against Python, JavaScript and Go, so every package returns identical results.
The finest level of Nigerian geography, each record with a source.
PyPI, npm, Go modules and django-naija, plus a free REST API on Cloudflare Workers.
